examples.english: A large store was built in the suburbs.

notes:
{大型|おおがた} describes something of large size or scale. Used as a noun or pre-noun modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧ (large truck)
- {大型|おおがた}⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (large typhoon)
- {大型|おおがた}⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧ (large store)
- {大型|おおがた}⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧ (long holiday period)
- {大型|おおがた}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (large vehicle license)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大型|おおがた}: large (for products, weather, etc.)
- ⟦{中型|ちゅうがた}→中型：21242_chuugata⟧: medium-sized
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧: small-sized
